kawa_no_boushi.evidence: Leather Cap; 皮の帽子 → 革の帽子 is a spelling change for leather. Both have defense 1 and price 1.

energy_helm.evidence: Energy Helm; エネルギーヘルム → エナジーヘルム changes the transliteration of energy. Both are plain non-elemental helmets; defense/price change from 8/8 in 2010 to 10/10 in HTML5.

energy_armor.evidence: Energy Armor; エネルギーアーマー → エナジーアーマー changes the transliteration of energy. Both are plain non-elemental armor; defense/price change from 9/9 in 2010 to 11/10 in HTML5.
